description: Creates a structured public-safe markdown and JSON intake packet with business context, findings, risks, recommended workflow, missing information, and confidence.

aiIdea.description: AI or automation idea the user is considering.

bottleneckSummary.description: Structured bottleneck findings from a prior tool result.

businessContext.description: Structured business context from a prior tool result or user notes.

businessType.description: Type of business, such as ecommerce, SaaS, consulting, agency, local service, or solo business.

constraints.description: Known constraints such as budget, team capacity, tools, timeline, compliance needs, or data access.

currentGoal.description: Current business goal the user wants the review to support.

currentProblem.description: Main business or workflow problem the user wants to solve.

currentWorkflow.description: How the relevant workflow currently works, including manual steps, tools, handoffs, and review points.

goal90Days.description: Desired business or workflow outcome over the next 90 days.

notes.description: Any additional context the user wants considered in the review.

offer.description: Core product, service, package, or outcome the business sells.

opportunitySummary.description: Structured AI opportunity findings from a prior tool result.

preferredNextStep.description: Preferred next-step category or support style to include in the packet.

recommendedNextStep.description: Structured next-step recommendation from a prior tool result.

recommendedWorkflow.description: Structured first workflow recommendation from a prior tool result.

revenueModel.description: How the business earns revenue, such as projects, retainers, subscriptions, services, or products.

riskConcerns.description: Concerns related to customer trust, brand reputation, legal exposure, sensitive data, or quality control.

riskSummary.description: Structured trust and control risk findings from a prior tool result.

targetCustomer.description: Primary customer segment or buyer the business serves.

teamSize.description: Approximate team size and key roles involved in the workflow.

touchpointMap.description: Structured customer touchpoint map from a prior tool result.

userNotes.description: Additional notes the user wants included in the intake packet.

name: export_intake_packet

confidence.description: Confidence level based on the clarity and completeness of the provided business context.

missingInformation.description: Information the user should provide before deeper review or implementation.

packetJson.description: Structured intake packet data for handoff or deeper review.

packetMarkdown.description: Public-safe intake packet formatted as markdown.

recommendedPrivateReview.description: Public-safe recommendation for the next deeper review category.

title: Export Intake Packet
